body:
We used an offline VM running a copy of our Agie Classic Cut 2S machine control. We imported the two die openings in one plate. The control plotted ten cutting blocks, contained the cuts within their respective openings and applied the four inward offsets on all 76 faces. Each rough separation measured 1 mm.

All controller runs were offline. No physical cut was made.

Port to the current frame: head `1e12c77a4`, stacked on #2979 (`17cb6f617`).

- The merge of `17cb6f617` took the zero-step setup of #2984 for all conflicting files. The die pair is ported as behaviour onto that frame. The old writer is not used.
- New: `PunchGroup20::encode_die` (the PAIR20 records with `c_die`), die pairs in `export_group_with_review`, and rim matching to one of N openings in `operation/agie_die.rs`.
- The ported DUODI20 job was imported on the emulated control: `CCB030[0]` and Matrijs on both works, `CCB030[4]` with 245/155/140/134 µm after TECCUT, `geen fouten`, and a plot with no cutting move across the plate between the openings. The body has the full readings.
- Gate: quick gate green except the known red #3774. Strict clippy clean.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 1e12c77a4150252c34df3f23fc2ff1c85fe2e3fa -->
Needs changes before merge. This is a SAFETY-tier review.

I reviewed the full diff against current upstream/main and its current AGENTS.md. There is no earlier collaborator review on this head.

The local trial merge is `390978a6fd711d24b937b1bed32bfcfafe2558b9`. Its first parent is the PR head. Its main parent is `f2aa981b51a3453428fb294c6c71c575a0178ef6`.

The rim checks match each selection to a full-height opening. The group checks keep the complete cutting areas apart. Both works use one CCB030 quality. I found no code blocker.

Results, run locally:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: PASS. The geometry change selects the batch fallback. All 1,203 steps passed. There were no stalls. Strict clippy passed with `--all-targets -- -D warnings`.
- The app library: 305 passed. The UI library: 1,586 passed, 8 ignored.
- `example_catalog`: 39 passed, 4 ignored. `example_catalog_adaptive` and `example_catalog_edge_work`: 1 passed each.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: PASS. All 11 light tests passed across 6 steps, including the release prebuild. There were no failures or stalls.

Extra suites run:

I found the readers of the changed golden directories and ran these suites again by name after the quick gate.

- `camcraft-post --lib`: 143 passed.
- `camcraft-post --test agie_cutoff_setup`: 4 passed.
- `camcraft-post --test agie_die_group_setup`: 5 passed.
- `camcraft-post --test agie_group_setup`: 4 passed.
- `camcraft-post --test agie_safe_setup`: 8 passed.
- `camcraft-app --test agie_native`: 27 passed.
- `camcraft-app --test agie_quality`: 3 passed.

Mutations:

I ran two input mutations from the PR through the built CLI, in fresh temporary directories. I did not change the source.

- Same opening selected twice: RED. Export failed with the clear-band diagnostic. No job directory was written.
- Threading hole in the other opening: RED. Generation failed because the die start hole was outside its profile. No job directory was written.
- Original pair before and after the mutations: GREEN. Each run matched both ISO files, the SBL and the SBR byte for byte.

Goldens checked:

I read the added ISO, SBL and SBR lines. The die ISOs close their own contours and differ by the expected X translation. Each work binds its own geometry and hole. Both works state `c_die`, a 1 mm separation and the shared quality. The circle and racetrack arcs have the stated incremental centres. FINE20 changes the quality request. LOWER20 uses distinct air endpoints and no separation.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/wire_page.rs:235`: Add before and after screenshots to the PR body. This diff adds two visible cutoff controls. The body has no screenshots. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Do not commit them to the PR branch.
2. `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md:149`: Add `Process change: yes` to the PR body. This diff changes a process file. Leave `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` unchanged. Also put `Fixes #2977` at the end of the body, after the generated footer.
3. `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/agie-native/FINE20.ISO:1`: Add a `Goldens moved` section for the full current diff. List the added CIRCLE20, RACE20 and FINE20 files, plus DUODI201 and DUODI202. Also list the added DUODI20, LOWER20 and PAIR20 setup files in `crates/post/tests/golden/agie-setup/`. Explain the intended additions. The current body names the die-pair goldens but describes the inherited goldens as unchanged. These files are additions relative to current upstream/main.
4. `crates/app/tests/agie_quality.rs:1`, `crates/post/tests/agie_cutoff_setup.rs:1`, `crates/post/tests/agie_die_group_setup.rs:1`, `crates/post/tests/agie_group_setup.rs:1`: Give the required one-line reason for each new top-level test binary in the body. Alternatively, put the tests in existing domain directory suites. Current AGENTS.md requires this reason.

No physical cut was made. Full heavy lanes are not required for this P6 PR under current upstream/main policy.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
This PR goes back to draft for the review fixes. The fix moves the new top-level test binaries into existing suites. The PR is flagged ready again when the gate is green.
